lines.en: Hello, Gita. The bank closes at five today. Can I help you?

lines.en: Yes, please. Is the bank open on Saturday?

lines.en: And on Sunday? Is the ATM open then?

lines.en: Great. Are the doors locked at five exactly?

lines.en: Yes, they are locked at five, so please come back before that.
lines.pt: Sim, são trancadas às cinco, então volte antes disso.

facts.label: Horários e passivo
facts.sub: Use opens at, closes at, is open until e is closed on para horários. Com o passivo: Cards are made, they are sent.

facts.label: fecha às / abre às
facts.sub: Use opens at e closes at com horas: The bank opens at nine and closes at five. O verbo leva s com the bank. Para o fim use also until: open until seven.

facts.label: fica fechado em
facts.sub: Use is closed on + dia: The bank is closed on Sunday. Também: The doors are locked at five. É estado, por isso usamos is/are + particípio.

compare.ask: The bank is closed on Sunday.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “o banco fecha às cinco” e “o banco fica fechado no domingo”.
compare.tip: Diga: “The bank is closed on Sunday.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use closes at five para o horário e is closed on Sunday para o estado do banco. Com dia da semana, use on.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: A bank in Chicago · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold afternoon in Chicago. Ana walks into a bank near her office. She wants to know the opening hours. Dario works at the information desk. The bank closes early on some days. Ana needs a new card.
“Hello, Ana. The bank closes at five today. Can I help you?” says Dario. “Yes, please. Is the bank open on Saturday?” says Ana. “It opens at nine and closes at noon on Saturday.” says Dario.
